LNbits for macOS

Requires macOS 15 or later. Use the arm64 download for Apple Silicon
(M-series) Macs and the x86_64 download for Intel Macs.

Installation
Drag LNbits.app to Applications, eject this disk image, and open LNbits
from Applications. Choose your settings, click Launch LNbits, then
Open in browser. Python and Node.js do not need to be installed.

These builds are not Apple Developer ID signed or notarized. macOS may
block the first launch. If you trust the download, attempt to open it,
then use System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway and confirm.
You do not need to disable Gatekeeper or System Integrity Protection.

Data and updates
Wallets, settings, extensions and logs are stored separately from the app,
by default in ~/Library/Application Support/LNbits. The launcher lets you
choose another data folder. Keep that folder backed up.

To update, stop LNbits and quit the app before replacing it in Applications.
Replacing or removing the app does not remove your data folder.
Keep the launcher open while using LNbits. Stop LNbits or quit the launcher
to shut down its server.

Terminal usage
/Applications/LNbits.app/Contents/MacOS/LNbits --headless --port 5001
/Applications/LNbits.app/Contents/MacOS/LNbits --gui

Logs are in the selected data folder under logs/desktop.log.
Custom SSL_CERT_FILE or SSL_CERT_DIR environment settings are respected.

Project: https://lnbits.com
Source: https://github.com/lnbits/lnbits
